status_label: Official Ministry of Health situation report, V1, dated 16 August 2026, 07:30 WIB

headline.injury_figures_note: The 16 August, 07:30 WIB Kemenkes report states (on its summary slide) Luka Ringan/Rawat Jalan (minor/outpatient) = 50 and Luka Berat/Rawat Inap (serious/inpatient) = 104. Its per-district table is headed 'MD LB LR PGS' but the column that sums to 50 appears where 'LB' is labelled and the column summing to 104 appears where 'LR' is labelled — the reverse pairing from the summary slide. This SitRep follows the summary slide's explicit labels (minor=50, serious=104) for headline figures, and flags this apparent table/label mismatch in the source document rather than silently resolving it. This report's totals (154 injured) also differ from the same day's BNPB figure (101 injured) and the previous 15 August Kemenkes report (113 injured, 36 serious/77 minor) — all three are preserved rather than combined.

data_quality_notes: The report gives a date but no specific data cut-off time.
The puskesmas building-condition categories total 184, six fewer than the stated total of 190; these six are recorded as unclassified rather than assumed to be undamaged.
A dash in a district casualty cell is treated as no casualty report in the source table, not automatically as a verified zero.

BNPB reported 18 affected health facilities at 17:00 WIB, while the Ministry of Health report lists structural damage at 77 facilities. These are shown separately because definitions and cut-offs differ.

The 16 August, 07:30 WIB Kemenkes V1 report's per-district injury table appears to have its 'LB' (serious) and 'LR' (minor) columns in the opposite order from the report's own summary-slide labels; see headline.injury_figures_note.

Several figures in the 16 August V1 report's per-district table carry an asterisk in the source document with no visible footnote legend in the pages reviewed; this SitRep reproduces the numeric values without being able to confirm what the asterisk denotes.
disclaimer: Ministry of Health figures remain the primary source for detailed health-sector status. BNPB's separate count of 18 affected health facilities at 17:00 WIB is retained for comparison and is not combined with the Ministry of Health's 77 structurally damaged facilities. All figures remain preliminary.

cross_source_comparison.interpretation: Do not subtract or combine the figures. BNPB reports affected health facilities, while the Ministry of Health reports facilities classified with structural damage; definitions, source tables and cut-offs may differ.
